name: Storm Cirrus Shell
description: Three-layer waterproof shell for alpine summer summits and shoulder-season rain. Pit zips, helmet-compatible hood.

name: Cumulus 850 Down Jacket
description: 850-fill responsibly sourced down. A puffer light enough to stuff into a daypack but warm enough for camp at altitude.

name: Tussock Grid Fleece
description: Grid-knit midlayer that breathes uphill and holds heat at the col. Thumb loops, deep chest pocket.

name: Merino 200 Long-Sleeve
description: 200gsm New Zealand merino base layer. Odour-resistant for multi-day trips, flat seams that don't chafe under a pack.

name: Cascade Trail Runner
description: Cushioned trail runner with 4mm lugs for mixed terrain. Wide forefoot, rock plate underfoot.

name: Routeburn Mid GTX
description: Mid-cut waterproof hiking boot for tramping with a heavy pack. Lasting board for stability on rocky descents.

name: Tarn 38L Backpack
description: 38-litre touring pack with ice-axe loops, hipbelt pockets, and a hydration sleeve. Sized for fast & light overnighters.

name: Alpenglow 2P Tent
description: Two-person three-season tent. Cross-pole hub design pitches in under three minutes, even in wind.

name: Hollowfill 0°C Sleeping Bag
description: Synthetic 0°C comfort-rated bag that keeps insulating when damp. Ideal for coastal multi-days.

name: Beacon 400 Headlamp
description: 400-lumen rechargeable headlamp with red night mode and a lockout for pack-stowed travel.

name: Insulated 750ml Water Bottle
description: Double-wall stainless flask. Keeps tea hot to the summit and cold water cold on the climb out.

name: Pocketburner Canister Stove
description: Sub-100g titanium canister stove. Boils 500ml in under three minutes at sea level.

name: Folding Carbon Trekking Poles
description: Three-section folding carbon poles that collapse short enough for cabin baggage. Cork grips, EVA chokes.

name: Ribbed Merino Beanie
description: Soft ribbed merino beanie that fits under a helmet. Folds flat into a hipbelt pocket.

name: Windproof Liner Gloves
description: Windproof softshell liner gloves with touchscreen-friendly fingertips. Pair under a shell mitt for cold belays.

name: Aurora Women's 3L Shell
description: Women's three-layer waterproof shell cut for the trail. Articulated hood, underarm vents, and a drop hem for weather coming up the valley.

name: Featherline Women's Down Hoody
description: Women's 800-fill down hoody for cold belays and frosted mornings. Stuffs into its own pocket and weighs next to nothing.

name: Tussock Women's Grid Fleece
description: Women's grid-fleece midlayer that breathes on the climb and traps warmth at the col. Thumb loops and a low-bulk collar.

name: Merino 200 Women's Long-Sleeve
description: Women's 200gsm merino base layer that regulates on long days and resists odour over back-to-back huts. Flatlock seams.

name: Ridgeline Women's Hiking Tights
description: Women's stretch hiking tights with a high waist and two zip thigh pockets. Quick-drying, abrasion-resistant panels at the knee.

name: Summit Women's Support Bra
description: Women's medium-support sports bra in moisture-wicking knit. Soft underband and racerback for full range on the trail.

name: Stormfront Gore-Tex Rain Jacket
description: Ultralight Gore-Tex 3-layer rain jacket with sealed seams and adjustable hood.
